svg.text: Where the mass sits, before and after (X.1)
“She slowly took off her ___”, 50 lineage pairs; darker = more of the slot’s probability
Each garment shaded by the median share of the slot it holds in that arm; one ramp serves both bodies, stretched as (share)^0.45 so the thin end stays legible.
Labels read: garment, its share of the slot in that arm, and the signed change aligned − base in percentage points (the same number on both sides).
The 27 garments drawn hold 47.4% of the slot at base and 44.5% after alignment. Recomputed 2026-09-18 from the movement store, 50 lineage-representative pairs, median per lineage.
